summary: MaintService is a web-based administrative screen for managing service records within the HSPnet application. It provides a complex UI for listing, adding, editing, deleting, and reactivating service entries, as well as assigning service contacts and validating user roles. The screen incorporates dynamic permissions, advanced UI elements including modal popups, error/warning panels, and custom validation logic. It is tightly integrated with user session data, agencies, sites, and various business rules regarding user roles and edit access.
purpose: To allow authorized users to maintain (add, edit, inactivate, reactivate) service records within an agency/site context, and to control assignment and validation of service contacts according to specific business rules and user permissions.

workflows.name: Add/Edit Service
steps: User selects Agency and Site from dropdowns (filtered by permissions).
User clicks Add or Edit All to enter grid edit mode.
ServiceAddList and ContactList are loaded for dropdown data.
User fills service details and selects service contact (staff).
Custom validator ensures valid staff contact selection.
On save, system checks if Placement Coordinator can edit service contact (business rule).
On success, updates service records and refreshes grid.

workflows.name: Inactivate/Delete/Reactivate Service
steps: User clicks inactivate or delete button.
System checks permissions (cannot delete if destination exists unless sysadmin).
User can reactivate service using reactivate option.

workflows.name: Service Contact Assignment
steps: User selects service contact from dropdown (staff members).
System syncs dropdowns for HSPnet user status.
If Placement Coordinator, checks business rule: can only assign non-HSPnet user if only one active.
If selection is invalid, displays error.

business_rules: System Administrators can edit any service in their own agency.
Local Administrators can edit if assigned to site.
Placement Coordinators can edit service contact if it's not an HSPnet user and only one is active.
Users cannot edit services in their own agency unless they have explicit role permissions.
Cannot delete/inactivate service if a destination exists unless user is sysadmin.
validations: CustomValidator checks valid ServiceContact selection (cannot be -1).
Staff contact must exist or be added if not found.
HSPnet user assignment: if hdnSCEditableOnly is '1', PC users cannot assign HSPnet users.
Row state changes to Edit if ServiceID > -1.
conditions: ScreenIsEditable is set based on user role and permissions.
blnCanEditAll is set if service is not inactive and user can edit.
SCEditableOnly is set if PC is editing a non-HSPnet user (business logic).
system_behavior: UpdatePanels and ModalPopups for edit/add screens.
Show/hide buttons based on permissions and row state.
Hide add/edit buttons on read-only screens.
Set up JavaScript variables for dirty tracking (edit state).
dependencies: UI depends on Agency and Site dropdowns, which are dynamically filtered.
Service data sourced from ObjectDataSource, filtered by site, active/inactive, keyword.
UserSession required for permissions checks and variable storage.
Help text and standards links depend on Help records for ServiceDataStandards/ServiceGlossary.
exceptions: PC users trying to assign HSPnet users as service contact (shows error).
Service cannot be edited if user is view-only or lacks permission.
Cannot delete/inactivate if destination exists unless sysadmin.
content_gaps: Fragmentation of UI and code-behind content limits full workflow reconstruction.
Some business logic references external resources or methods not fully documented in these sources (e.g., Service.ProfileExists, HelpRecord retrieval, NameFormatter, Grid helper methods).
Data source schema (Service, Staff, Codes) is referenced but not provided.
Error messages and internationalization rely on Resources object, details not included.
No detailed exception handling logic for database failures or invalid user session.
